Because the delta burn is logged at the lagoon settlement, the vine audit exposes the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 93% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 350 account operation therefore ties up 2 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
